summary: Frontend-only testing of the three new Song Coder features: Release Countdown, Artist Profiles, Catalog Reordering, plus mode-toggle sync and 390x844 mobile layout. All scenarios passed. Reset mock, configured settings (token=testtoken, api base=mock), then exercised each feature end-to-end against the mock GitHub API.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html is now ~1790 lines; still intentionally single-file but future features should prompt modularization.

Seed content/songs.html has 58 total <ul class="song"> tags (56 live + 2 inside an HTML comment at line 503). The feature spec says 'total ul.song count still 56' – minor doc/spec mismatch, not a bug. The catalog UI correctly parses 56 live songs; after reorder the raw file still has 58 ul.song (56 live + 2 commented preserved).
test_credentials: Mock GitHub token: any non-empty string ('bad' => 401). API base: https://music-catalog-sync.preview.emergentagent.com/api/mockgh
seed_data_creation: POST /api/mockgh/reset at the start of each scenario group. Created TEST artists ('TEST Artist Soon' via PR, 'TEST GoLive Artist' via live) and 'TEST Upcoming Song' with a future release date for countdown verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
